label: preparing
what: Innkeeper, freight and builder are jointly preparing an evening gathering with substantial bread refreshments in the town hall great hall at 18:00. Its stated cover or description is civic hospitality and community gatherings, but its actual occasion and detailed agenda have not been disclosed to me. Baker supplies bread, including builder's paid additional eighty loaves; secretary arranges the appointment and escort. There is insufficient evidence to identify a more specific purpose or establish that these helpers know the undisclosed occasion.
